initialExam.title: UGC NET (National Eligibility Test) 2026
initialExam.description: UGC NET determines eligibility for Assistant Professor and JRF in Indian universities and colleges. Exam ongoing 22-30 Jun 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Master's Degree with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC/PwD)
initialExam.ageLimit: No age limit for Asst Prof, 31 for JRF
initialExam.syllabus: Paper-I: Teaching Aptitude, Research Methodology, Comprehension, Communication, ICT, Higher Education, Reasoning, Environment, People & Development. Paper-II: Subject-specific (83 subjects available).
initialExam.examPattern: Paper-I: 50 questions, 100 marks. Paper-II: 100 questions, 200 marks. Total: 3 hours. No negative marking.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Qualify UGC NET → Apply for Assistant Professor/JRF posts
initialExam.jobRole: Assistant Professor in Universities/Colleges, Junior Research Fellow
initialExam.careerGrowth: Asst Professor → Associate Professor → Professor → Head of Department → Dean → Vice Chancellor.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ugcnet.nta.ac.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Academic leave, Research grants, Sabbatical

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: No age limit for Assistant Professor eligibility
